headline: IPG merger fuels sharp revenue and earnings growth
summary_short: Omnicom's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 63.4% y/y to $6,562.5 million, mainly reflecting the completed IPG merger plus 6.1% organic growth in core operations, while diluted EPS climbed to $2.08 from $1.31 a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue grew 63.4% y/y to $6,562.5M, primarily from the November 2025 IPG acquisition, 6.1% organic growth in core operations, and $69.0M of favorable FX. Core-operations Adjusted EBITA margin expanded to 17.8% from 15.9% on cost-reduction synergies; GAAP operating margin was 14.1%, held back by $87.1M of IPG integration and severance costs (vs $154.8M a year ago). Net income attributable to Omnicom rose 127.0% y/y to $584.8M; diluted EPS was $2.08 (Non-GAAP adjusted EPS $2.65, +29.3%), helped by a lower effective tax rate (27.1% vs 30.2%) but diluted by ~43% more weighted-average shares from IPG-related issuance. Net interest expense rose $52.6M on IPG-related debt. No balance-sheet or cash-flow figures were disclosed in this release.
